description: Redwood Inference’s Developer Experience org is building “Quickstart templates” for RAG + agents that are production-minded by default: opinionated project scaffolds that help developers go from sign-up to a deployed, observable app with safe defaults (timeouts/retries, streaming robustness, cost controls, guardrails) and clear operational hooks (metrics, traces, logs, error taxonomy). The scope includes multiple language/framework templates (initially Python + TypeScript), a small template CLI/scaffolder, standardized observability instrumentation (OpenTelemetry + Redwood-specific conventions), and documentation updates that integrate templates into the docs IA and SDK guides. Key stakeholders: DevEx (Alex Martinez, Monica Patel, Elliot Price, Wei Chen), Hosted API PM leadership (Nikhil Sharma/Henry Cho) for API ergonomics and telemetry requirements, and Observability/SRE (Allison Grant/Sergio Costa/Christine Wong) to ensure templates emit useful signals and match internal standards. Execution phases: (1) discovery/requirements + template spec and success metrics; (2) build core scaffolding, RAG baseline, and agent baseline with eval + smoke tests; (3) observability hooks + dashboards and error taxonomy alignment; (4) docs-site integration and launch readiness (release process, versioning, support playbooks); (5) iterate based on early user feedback and support tickets. Constraints: templates must avoid insecure defaults (keys handling, PII), be resilient to streaming/network issues, keep vendor lock-in minimal (provider abstraction), and remain easy to maintain via CI and versioned releases.
